events.title: ECMAScript 2025 standardized
events.summary: Ecma adopted ECMAScript 2025 in June 2025 — adding import attributes, iterator helpers, and JSON module imports.
events.about: ES2025 makes importing JSON modules first-class and adds iterator utilities for functional-style pipelines in plain JavaScript. Each annual release lets browsers ship features without waiting for massive 'ES6-sized' bundles.

narrative.whyChosen: ES2025 continued the stable yearly rhythm for JavaScript platform evolution.
narrative.whyImportant: Import attributes and JSON modules simplify bundler-free tooling in Node and browsers.
narrative.problemSolved: Developers relied on bundler-specific hacks to import non-JS assets as modules.
